# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 71 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 71

Jesus said: "I will destroy this house, and no one will be able to build it again."

---

**Council Notes:**

- This is the Thomas version of the temple saying (cf. Mark 14:58; John 2:19). Crucially, Thomas:
  1. Does not say "temple" — just "house"
  2. Has no three-day rebuilding promise
  3. The destruction is final and absolute
- This may be: (a) a purer form of the saying before temple-interpretation, (b) a deliberate de-eschatologizing in Thomas, or (c) a reference to the ego/body ("house" as dwelling of the soul).
- "Destroy" (EMET) is preferred over "tear down" (LOGOS) — broader semantic range fits the ambiguity; "bring down" (PNEUMA) is too colloquial for this charged saying.
- The absolute finality ("no one will be able to build it again") is the Thomasine distinctive: no resurrection reversal is promised here.
